PRODUCT & DESIGN · PROJECT

Todoist as a true non-technical agent

Ideas for how Todoist could lead in an agent-first world without overwhelming its users.

Has anybody already built a to-do app that becomes an agent for everyday people?

THE PROJECT · 10 SCREENS

The question

Todoist is where people decide what to do. How does it become the place where it gets done?

The approach

Start with cohorts — the productivity guru, the backlog collector, the family COO, the workflow architect — and design how each plans their day and week, then let the agent act on the list.

The tradeoff

Power users want control and newcomers want simplicity; agent features have to stay invisible until they help.

What to take with you

Knowing exactly who you are solving for is step one of any useful agent.
